title: The Blacksmith Job Scheduling Profit
statement:
A royal blacksmith has N job requests. Each job i has a Deadline D[i] (latest unit time slot it can finish) and a Profit P[i]. Each job takes exactly 1 unit of time to complete. Only one job can be scheduled at any time slot.

Find the maximum profit achievable by scheduling jobs within their deadlines.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Next N lines: Two integers D[i] and P[i].

sampleCases.explanation: Pick job 3 (prof 40, dead 1) and job 1 (prof 20, dead 4). Total = 60.
Schedule job with 100 at slot 2, job with 27 at slot 1.
